scope: same-capacity measured shape efficiency transferred only to expert/fused-dispatch work with original full-input/common/shared scope preserved

attention_provenance.module_scope: projection + compressor/indexer + sparse attention + output projection
attention_provenance.kv_cache_source_layout: fp8 source table; serving reference plain FP8
attention_provenance.extrapolation: measured boundary with parameterized DSV4 FLOP/byte SOL growth, max 64x

extrapolation_sol.model: DSV4 FLOP/byte roofline anchored to measured boundary efficiency
extrapolation_sol.basis: AIC dsv4_attention_sol_ms; local grouped FP8 output and BF16 compressors from vLLM
extrapolation_sol.cache_layout_evidence: source-table layouts inferred from collector defaults and current vLLM; historical version unverified
extrapolation_sol.efficiency: measured(boundary) / SOL(boundary); no fitted throughput multiplier

attention_provenance.extrapolation_axis_binding: each inner-axis growth uses its measured outer-axis node
attention_provenance.decode_batch_composition: query-row-weighted uniform full-batch module estimates; common projections counted once
attention_provenance.capture_projection_rows: positive shared SOL increment beyond actual-query source floors at eligible descriptor rows; sparse/indexer query ownership unchanged

mixed_batch_composition.shared_scope: full-tensor input/output, compressor-input and index-query/weight projections, weights and activation preparation
mixed_batch_composition.phase_scope: sparse attention, index scoring/KV reads and compressor pointwise work; context and decode kept separate
mixed_batch_composition.allocation: two SOL roofline bounds normalized to each whole-module sample; common efficiency row-weighted at total query rows
mixed_batch_composition.source_clamps: each phase retains its source geometry; common rows retain the largest source floor
mixed_batch_composition.homogeneous: single context group and decode-only batches unchanged
mixed_batch_composition.uncertainty: whole-module tables do not measure component launches, ragged fusion or aux-stream overlap; no extra overlap credit

attention_provenance.decode_query_width: expanded query compute and sparse-attention reads; indexer KV reuse within Q-blocks

mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.basis: pinned DeepGEMM SM100 paged MQA groups request Q-blocks; BLOCK_Q = 128 / indexer heads
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.query_math: unchanged at the full expanded query-row count
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.indexer_kv_read_fraction: sum(requests * ceil(query width / BLOCK_Q)) / query rows, per context; source geometry including clamps
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.cross_q_block_l2_reuse: not credited without measured traffic; tile reads are a conservative streaming estimate
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.sparse_attention_kv_reads: per query retained; FlashInfer sparse indices may differ across queries
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.latency: measured full-query-row module times adjusted/source SOL; math bound retained

attention_provenance.generation_ragged_grid: on out-of-range neighbors, use same-geometry batch slices within the existing 64x context/batch bound
attention_provenance.context_query_grid: query floors across prefixes for the matching geometry/batch; coupled query/prefix samples do not inflate supported queries

moe_description.num_tokens_scope: rank-local after TP/SP and eligible graph padding
moe_description.unequal_ranks: full-input uniform measured anchor normalized by physical expert, dispatch/scan/combine work; no mean-row substitution
moe_description.valid_rows: padding top-k=-1; contiguous SP masks; idle/dummy and MTP valid requests separate from full captured rows

work_composition.basis: pinned DeepGEMM input-selected BLOCK_M, valid expert tasks, pre-dispatch/scan and source-side combine
work_composition.normalization: target physical phase work / matching full-input uniform phase work; whole measured module anchor retained
work_composition.expert_spectrum: global power_law_1.01 integer spectra; fixed MT19937 float32 draws0/1/2, rounding/clipping/round-robin conservation; synthetic, not recovered historical routes
work_composition.spectrum_placement: mean critical costs over all cyclic hot-rank placements; each retains max-rank work and full-input BLOCK_M; no mean-row module substitution
work_composition.spectrum_rounding: float32 inverse-CDF; NumPy/Torch reduction differences may move boundary counts, exact integer selection bounds retained
work_composition.mma_rows: valid expert task tails aligned to16; per-expert16*ceil(received/16); mean critical-rank arithmetic over synthetic samples
work_composition.compute_pipe: catalog FP8 theoretical peak for the mixed MXF8F6F4 path; not pure FP4 storage-dtype peak
work_composition.compute_rate_grade: D pipe-family inference from pinned opcode/operands; mixed-input issue cycles and efficiency unmeasured
work_composition.weight_traffic: full weight/scales per M task; dynamic MMA tails do not reduce TMA loads; issued bytes are not measured HBM misses
work_composition.uncertainty: no measured component timers/histograms, historical DeepGEMM revision, tile cache traffic or unequal-rank phase overlap
work_composition.cache_credit: no cross-M-tile weight L2 reuse credited
work_composition.full_input_work: input preparation/scans, block choice and output reduction preserved even for padding

expert_phase_efficiency.grade: D: whole uniform module efficiency allocated to expert/fused-dispatch phase; component efficiency not measured
expert_phase_efficiency.source: same phase/effective-capacity raw module rows; at least3 distinct expert-work coordinates
expert_phase_efficiency.common_scope: startup, full-input preparation/scans and final combine retain source-anchor efficiency
expert_phase_efficiency.expert_scope: critical expert/fused-dispatch work after integer sampling and full-input BLOCK_M; normalized measured shape efficiency ratio
expert_phase_efficiency.identity: uniform source anchor retained exactly; source-relative efficiency ratio equals1 at identical expert work
expert_phase_efficiency.fallback: missing/singleton capacity, ambiguous work coordinate, cross-capacity or cross-buffer interpolation retain original physical normalization

moe_description.collector_regime: generation for small tokens, context for large, explicit interpolation in the gap
moe_description.buffer_capacity: collector capacities retained; serving capacity differs
moe_description.historical_shared_fusion: unverified; current pinned source supports native FP8 shared fusion
moe_description.tp_communication: existing TP approximation; full native attention/SP communication validation pending
